messages:
Maya: Hey — running into a weird parity issue between node and python SDKs when using jsonmode + fn_call. Node returns an array-wrapped tool payload, py returns object. Both using same schema in sample-app.
Kevin: ugh. can you paste the minimal prompt + schema? also is this with the new retry wrapper enabled?
Maya: repro attached (short):
```
schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"action":{"type":"string"}},"required":["action"]}
prompt: 'call_tool with {action: "create"}'
```
node: gets `[{"action":"create"}]`
py: gets `{"action":"create"}`
Both on jsonmode, fn_call=tool
Jordan: interesting — did you run through the SDK helper that coerces arrays for compatibility? we added that in node last month for some toolchains.
Maya: i didn't intentionally add any helper. sample-app is stock starterkit with sdk v1.2.0 on node and 1.2.0 on py. i think the node helper might be injecting the array.
Sam: quick workaround: in the SDK config you can force strict schema mode for tool responses: `sdk.config.jsonMode.strict = true` — makes both sides error instead of coerced. Not ideal but narrows root cause.
Maya: thanks, that at least surfaced the coercion. stacktrace shows transform at `sdk/helpers/normalizeToolResp.js` in node.
Kevin: ok can you open a tiny GH issue with stacktrace + sample? tag @eng-ml and @devex. i'll prioritize a parity spike.
Maya: filed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/482 — includes curl, node snippet, py snippet and logs. please note auth retry also appears in logs before transform — might be related.
Jordan: auth retry injecting a wrapper? possible — our retry wrapper rewrites raw response bytes for logging and we had one bug that double-encoded a JSON string on 401->retry path.
Sam: repro I used:
```bash
# node quick repro
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEMP' -d '{"jsonmode":true, "tool_call":true, "prompt":"call"}'
```
when temp token expired it retried with new token and response looked like `"[{\"action\":\"create\"}]"` before helper ran.
Maya: ahhh that explains the array-wrapped string getting parsed differently by node helper.
Kevin: plan: 1) patch retry wrapper to not re-stringify the body on retry (eng-infra), 2) add a unit test for node/py parity on toolcall schema, 3) add a small sample-app test in CI that runs both sdks against the tiny fixture.
Jordan: also add a short note in devex docs about how jsonmode + retry can surface as double-encoded payloads and the temporary mitigation option (`jsonMode.strict=true`).
deploy-bot: deploy queued for infra/retry-fix (#infra-789) — ETA 45m :rocket:
Maya: awesome, thanks. leaving the sample-app pinned to strict mode for now and will remove once tests confirm parity.
Kevin: sweet. add the sample-app change as a tiny PR and @mention me. thanks for filing the issue and including logs — saved a lot of time :+1:
Maya: will do, filing PR now.
